newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Two Nigerians among Moslems killed in haj fire.
newsitem.headline: Two Nigerians among Moslems killed in haj fire.

text.p: Two Nigerian women were among 343 pilgrims killed when fire razed tents for Moslems attending the haj in Saudi Arabia, local newspapers reported on Thursday.
The two were from Kaduna in predominantly northern Nigeria.
The semi-official Daily Times said they were killed in a stampede that followed the fire outbreak and their death had been confirmed by Nigeria's consulate in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.
There are more than 20,000 Nigerians performing the haj.
Most of the dead from the fires were Indians, Pakistanis and Bangladeshis.
